portsSource.note: MX405/410/415 user guide pp.14-21 (MX400DP desktop base, cable wiring, logic, specifications)

_avail.portsMissing: Dimensions of the MX400DP are not given in the MX4xx user guide.

ports.label: Gooseneck In
ports.notes: Keyed twist-lock socket for MX405 / MX410 / MX415 gooseneck (audio and LED)

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: 6.1 m attached cable, 3-pin male XLR, active balanced; powered by 48-52 V DC phantom (8 mA)

ports.label: Logic Switch Out
ports.notes: Logic output (mute switch). Unterminated white wire in the attached cable; active low, sinks up to 20 mA, TTL; logic ground = green wire

ports.label: Logic LED In
ports.notes: Logic input (LED control). Unterminated orange wire in the attached cable; active low (<=1.0 V), TTL; logic ground = green wire
